title: unstarted ai project
tagline: i did not get to start it really, but: run open-source LLMs from anywhere on a decentralized compute network
description: NOTE: I would ignore this if you are a judge reading this, as I did not even have the time to really start and get things working. The idea was to create a project where you could run open source LLMs using lilypad, but unfortunately I ran into lots of issues trying to get the stack to work and did not have enough time. The problem being solved is that although lots of open source LLMs exist and hold potential, they are still heavily trusted when there could be a viable alternative that removes as much trust as possible.
how_its_made: NOTE: again I must reiterate that I would not continue reading this. The goal was to utilize ipfs/filecoin for storage and lilypad for the actual computation, then store the result back in ipfs/filecoin. Then the idea was to make it easy to share the message history to train more models. The models would become modules on lilypad, but their files themselves would be stored so that anyone can download and fine tune them.
